title: Backup protection plan approval binding
$comment: Private file platform/recovery/approval.yaml. A merged PR carrying this binding approves exactly one input content hash (sha256 over the accepted public profiles bytes plus every reviewed protection.yaml bytes) and one plan digest; the backup protection reconciler applies that plan with no second operator command. Merging the approval PR keeps the binding bytes identical, so the approval stays satisfiable; stale or mismatched bindings never apply. Plans only write recovery policy, timers, and credentials; any restore, delete, or job-start action is refused.
